title: Como funciona Tripadvisor: guia para o negócio local

facts.fact: The Harmo blog states that Tripadvisor averages 456 million unique monthly visitors, a figure the page gives without naming a source.
facts.quote: Com uma média de 456 milhões de visitantes únicos mensais

facts.fact: The Harmo blog states that Tripadvisor has approximately 435 million reviews and opinions covering 6.8 million accommodations, restaurants and attractions, a figure the page gives without naming a source.
facts.quote: aproximadamente 435 milhões de avaliações e opiniões sobre 6,8 milhões de acomodações, restaurantes e atrações

facts.fact: The Harmo blog says Tripadvisor operates in 49 markets around the world.
facts.quote: que opera em 49 mercados ao redor do mundo

facts.fact: The Harmo blog cites unnamed research stating that about 93% of consumers say online reviews influence their purchase decisions.
facts.quote: Cerca de 93% dos consumidores afirmam que as avaliações online impactam suas decisões de compra

facts.fact: A 2016 Statista study, as cited by the Harmo blog, found that 86% of millennials had their decisions about where to stay influenced by Tripadvisor.
facts.quote: foi identificado que 86% dos millennials tiveram suas decisões sobre onde se hospedar influenciadas pelo Tripadvisor

facts.fact: The Harmo blog states that Tripadvisor was founded in 2000.
facts.quote: Fundada em 2000, tornou-se um dos maiores sites de turismo do mundo

facts.fact: The Harmo blog defines Generation Y, or millennials, as people born between 1980 and 2000.
The Harmo blog article was first published on 03/09/2020 and lists 11/11/2026 as its update date.
